name: YNX Music
title: YNX Music — Lawful Testnet Streaming and Creator Publishing
metaDescription: Explore a rights-aware YNX Music testnet for lawful audio playback, private libraries, creator drafts, evidence-backed publishing and review-only payment and dispute flows.
h1: Music with verifiable rights and honest settlement status
summary: YNX Music is an independent listener and creator application. It separates private drafts from the public catalog, records rights evidence for every upload, streams authorized media with Range support and keeps payments, Trust cases and AI actions behind explicit review boundaries.
statusLabel: Local testnet candidate; central integration and public deployment are not verified
features: Discover, search, private library, favorites, queue and playback progress
HTTP Range playback and private offline-cache candidate
Creator onboarding, owned or licensed source upload and private drafts
Rights declaration, provenance, evidence reference and territory fields
Review-only YNX Pay settlement intents and YNX Trust dispute adapters
Consent-based AI playlist proposals with approve or reject controls
Twelve interface languages with Arabic right-to-left support
truthBoundaries: No commercial catalog is bundled or claimed.
Only owned, licensed, public-domain or clearly test-only audio may be used.
A completed local play is not a paid royalty event.
Settlement intents remain requires-wallet-review until canonical Pay and Billing evidence exists.
No fake listeners, play counts, royalties, income guarantees or production signatures are claimed.

faq.question: Does YNX Music include commercial songs?
faq.answer: No. The current testnet package does not claim a commercial catalog. Testing is limited to repository-generated tones or media with direct ownership, license or public-domain evidence.

faq.question: Does a stream automatically create a royalty?
faq.answer: No. Playback usage and revenue evidence are separate. A creator settlement remains review-only until canonical Pay and Billing Ledger evidence is accepted.

faq.question: Can AI publish music or move creator funds?
faq.answer: No. AI may organize playlists, draft metadata or explain recommendations, but users must review actions and AI cannot publish, delete, sign, pay or accept rights.

faq.question: Are Android and iOS downloads available?
faq.answer: Not yet. Android artifacts have been built locally but are not immutably hosted, and the current iOS Simulator CI build is failing.

faq.question: Is YNX Music deployed publicly?
faq.answer: No verified public runtime or website publication is claimed for the current source commit.
